assumptions.wageSource: Government of Canada Job Bank, Ontario NOC41101 median
assumptions.interpretation: Wage is sourced. All times, price, rate allocations, workload and costs are declared sensitivity coordinates. Ordinary Word-like review ranges are not measured Microsoft workflow times. Zero incremental ordinary-tool license assumes an already licensed user; no subscription quote is invented.
